diagnostics.message: :module.csi: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit `depends_on = [module.eks]` on `:module.csi` is redundant: the module already depends on `:module.eks` implicitly through its attribute references to `module.eks.cluster.name` (`eks_name`) and `module.eks.oidc` (`oidc`) in the addons configuration. Terraform already orders the module after the EKS cluster, so the explicit depends_on adds no ordering and only couples the modules unnecessarily.
